title: Buy/Sell Stock
description: Track the minimum price seen so far; compute profit at each step. Single pass, O(1) space.

notes: `best` starts at 0 — if prices only decline, you simply hold (profit 0, not negative).
You can’t sell before you buy, so `minSoFar` must come from earlier iterations.
Initialize `minSoFar` to Infinity (or use `prices[0]` and start at index 1).

options: You can hold without selling for 0 profit
minSoFar is the global minimum of all prices
minSoFar is the minimum of all PRIOR prices

exercises.prompt: Fill in the running-minimum stock solution.
Same pattern, different prices — fill the running-minimum comparator and the profit expression.

blanks.hint: update minSoFar when p is smaller

L3.prompt: Write `maxProfit(prices)` — max profit from one buy then one sell. Log `maxProfit([7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4])`.
hints: Track the minimum price seen so far.
At each step, the best profit ending here = p - minSoFar.
